found_by: the CI fuzz smoke job (fuzz-macos), read-write mode, on the first run that built the harness on a runner: libFuzzer timeout after 20 s
base: a read-write mutant of a 5 MiB seed; kept whole rather than minimised -- it is mostly zeros and gzips to a few kilobytes

edits.what: a group descriptor's free-inodes count disagrees with its inode bitmap
edits.note: the descriptor says free inodes remain; the bitmap has no clear bit

symptom: ext4_ialloc_alloc_inode found the group's bitmap full (ENOSPC), released the group, and did `continue` -- skipping the ++bgid at the bottom of its loop. The same group was re-read, its checksum re-verified and its bitmap re-scanned forever: a create on a read-write mount never returned. Reproduced here: `ext4dump create /x` ran past a 60 s deadline.
fixed_by: patch 0074 -- the ENOSPC branch advances to the next group
reproduce: build/bin/ext4dump create /x # returns in about a second with the patch; never without it
